column6: Iranian forces seized an American underwater drone in the Strait of Hormuz.
Houthi rebels seized the key Red Sea port of Mocha and the surrounding coast from Saudi-backed government forces in a significant ground offensive.
Repeated large-scale detonations and demolitions of villages across southern Lebanon as part of the ongoing IDF ground operation.
Houthi rebel fighters captured the strategic volcanic island of Perim in the Bab al-Mandab strait after UN-backed government forces retreated.
Significant ground fighting between Iran-aligned Houthi forces and Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces resulting in high casualties.
IDF forces destroyed a major underground Hezbollah base; the resulting detonation was equivalent to a 4.1 magnitude earthquake.
